summary: Fixed critical bug in SQLAlchemy event listener registration for SearchableMixin

identified_issues.title: Model-Specific Event Registration
identified_issues.description: Event listeners were hardcoded to the Post model using event.listen(db.session, 'before_commit', Post.before_commit). This meant only Post changes would trigger indexing.
identified_issues.impact: Comment and any other SearchableMixin subclasses would have their changes silently ignored by the index system, leading to stale search results.

identified_issues.title: Silent Failures for New Models
identified_issues.description: When Comment inherited from SearchableMixin, no automatic event binding occurred. Developers had to manually register each new model, which is error-prone.
identified_issues.impact: High maintenance burden; easy to forget registering new searchable models, resulting in unreliable search index.

identified_issues.title: Broken Polymorphism in after_commit
identified_issues.description: The after_commit method called cls.add_to_index(obj) where cls was always the Post class, not the actual model class. This breaks polymorphic dispatch.
identified_issues.impact: If different models need different indexing strategies, they cannot override add_to_index effectively.

identified_issues.title: Lack of Centralized Registration API
identified_issues.description: Event binding logic was scattered across the codebase. No clear initialization point for developers to register listeners.
identified_issues.impact: Reduces maintainability and makes it harder to debug event binding issues.

identified_issues.title: Incomplete Test Coverage
identified_issues.description: Original test suite was placeholder-level; did not verify multi-model behavior or verify actual index operations.
identified_issues.impact: Bugs like this one slip through without detection.

fixes_applied.title: Session-Level Event Registration
fixes_applied.description: Changed from model-level to session-level event listening using event.listen(db_instance.session.__class__, ...). Session-level events fire once per session and receive the session as the first argument.
fixes_applied.impact: All SearchableMixin subclasses are now automatically detected via isinstance() checks.

fixes_applied.title: Centralized register_listeners() Method
fixes_applied.description: Added SearchableMixin.register_listeners(db) class method that registers all necessary event handlers in one call. This method should be called once during app initialization.
fixes_applied.impact: Single source of truth for listener registration. No need to re-register when new models inherit SearchableMixin.

fixes_applied.title: Dynamic isinstance() Checks
fixes_applied.description: Updated before_commit and after_commit to use isinstance(obj, SearchableMixin) instead of hardcoded type checks. This detects all subclasses automatically.
fixes_applied.impact: Any new model inheriting SearchableMixin is automatically indexed without code changes.

fixes_applied.title: Polymorphic Method Dispatch
fixes_applied.description: Changed obj.__class__.add_to_index(obj) instead of cls.add_to_index(obj). This calls the correct class's implementation.
fixes_applied.impact: Each model can now properly override indexing methods, supporting different indexing strategies.

fixes_applied.title: State Management Fix
fixes_applied.description: Fixed session._changes to be reset at the start of each before_commit() instead of after after_commit(). This prevents state pollution between commits.
fixes_applied.impact: Multiple consecutive commits work correctly without errors.

fixes_applied.title: Comprehensive Test Suite
fixes_applied.description: Created 15 test cases covering: individual model indexing, multi-model behavior, non-searchable models, state management, polymorphic dispatch, and regression issues.
fixes_applied.impact: Future changes can be validated against comprehensive test suite; bugs are caught early.

TestPostIndexing.description: Verify Post objects are indexed on add, update, delete

TestCommentIndexing.description: Verify Comment objects are indexed on add, update, delete

TestMultiModelBehavior.description: Verify mixed add/update/delete with multiple models works

TestIndexState.description: Verify state management and multiple commits work

TestPolymorphicDispatch.description: Verify correct class methods are called (polymorphism)

key_improvements.maintainability: Single call to register_listeners() handles all current and future SearchableMixin subclasses
key_improvements.reliability: isinstance() checks automatically detect new models without manual registration
key_improvements.correctness: Polymorphic dispatch ensures each model's indexing logic is properly called
key_improvements.debuggability: Centralized registration logic makes it easy to trace event binding issues
key_improvements.testability: Comprehensive test coverage validates multi-model scenarios and edge cases
key_improvements.extensibility: New SearchableMixin subclasses require zero changes to event registration code

known_limitations: Current implementation uses print() for index operations. Production code should use proper logging.
add_to_index and remove_from_index are placeholders and must be overridden in actual implementations.
No built-in support for asynchronous indexing; external task queue needed for production use.
recommendations: Consider adding logging instead of print statements for production environments
Implement custom add_to_index/remove_from_index in each searchable model
Consider adding batch indexing support for bulk operations
Consider integrating with Elasticsearch, Algolia, or similar search backends
Add metric collection for index update performance monitoring
Consider implementing index versioning for zero-downtime reindexing
